Class AppContext

java.lang.Object
qmillionaire.controller.AppContext
public final class AppContext extends Object
Central controller of the application.

The AppContext object owns the primary stage and the current set of user preferences (active Locale, color Theme and JavaFX stylesheet). Every view delegates navigation and preference reads to this controller so that switching language or theme triggers a global UI rebuild from a single place.

  • Constructor Details

    • AppContext

      public AppContext(javafx.stage.Stage stage)
      Builds an AppContext bound to the supplied primary stage. The default locale is English, the default theme is Theme.CLASSIC and the default Look & Feel is AppContext.LookAndFeel.MODENA.
      Parameters:
      stage - the primary stage owned by the JavaFX runtime
